properties.displayName: New Privileged Role Assignment at Subscription or RG Level
properties.description: Detects when a new role assignment granting Owner or Contributor rights is created in Azure Resource Manager.
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where CategoryValue =~ "Administrative"
| where OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success" or ActivityStatusValue =~ "Succeeded"
| extend Properties_d = parse_json(Properties)
| extend RoleDefinitionId = tostring(Properties_d.requestbody.Properties.RoleDefinitionId)
| extend PrincipalId = tostring(Properties_d.requestbody.Properties.PrincipalId)
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup, RoleDefinitionId, PrincipalId, OperationNameValue
| extend AccountCustomEntity = Caller, IPCustomEntity = CallerIpAddress
